quests.title: Chapter 1: Set Off for the Brightest Star
quests.summary: A new trainer takes over Team Sirius, down to its last member Mejiro McQueen, and must keep the team alive while she chases the Tenno Sho.
quests.start: Available from the start of the game.

parts.title: A New Era for Team Sirius

quests.title: Chapter 2: Little Big Ambition
quests.summary: Shy Rice Shower joins Team Sirius and sets her sights on stopping Mihono Bourbon's bid for the Triple Crown.
quests.start: Finish Chapter 1.

quests.title: Chapter 3: Embarking on the Dream Express
quests.summary: Winning Ticket dreams of the Japanese Derby while racing alongside her friends and rivals Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide.
quests.start: Finish Chapter 2 through Episode 13.

parts.title: BNW Showdown at the Satsuki Sho
Now I Know How It Feels

quests.title: Chapter 4: Roiling Craving
quests.summary: The restless Narita Brian hunts for rivals worthy of her talent while her older sister Biwa Hayahide watches over her.
quests.start: Finish Chapter 3.

parts.title: Still Hungry at the Arima Kinen

quests.title: Chapter 5: Scenery
quests.summary: Silence Suzuka runs to see a view no one else has seen, with Agnes Tachyon curious about the limits of her speed.
quests.start: Finish Chapter 4.

quests.title: Finale Part 1: A Dream in the Making
quests.summary: Special Week arrives at Tracen with a promise to become Japan's best, facing a strong generation that includes Seiun Sky and Mejiro Bright.
quests.start: Finish Chapter 5.

parts.title: What They Have and I Don't
Full of Ambition! The Japanese Derby

quests.title: Finale Part 2: Hope Shines On
quests.summary: Special Week continues her senior racing career and meets a challenger from overseas as Team Sirius' story builds to its close.
quests.start: Finish Finale Part 1.

parts.title: The Umamusume I Want to Be
Stage of the World's Strongest: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
